selected.title: SoFi Bank goes live with stablecoin settlement across Mastercard network
selected.summary: SoFi Bank has joined forces with Mastercard to migrate its full card programme to blockchain settlement using its own SoFiUSD stablecoin.
selected.why: Major shift in payments infrastructure as a bank migrates card settlements to its own stablecoin.

reason: SoFi's stablecoin settlement via Mastercard raises genuine debate about whether banks should control payment rails versus neutral infrastructure.
angle: Bank-issued stablecoins threaten payment system neutrality by letting individual institutions capture settlement infrastructure that should remain open.
